name: Ichinoe Kingyo
source:
Precise height: 146.1 cm

Console exclusive heroine. A first-year student who also works at the school's 8th cafeteria "Kamisore".

[spoiler]She is a shepherd like [url=/c11430]Nanai[/url] and the most strongest able to read 1000 books at the same time while Nanai is only capable of reading 10 books. Her real name is Kariya Misaki (刈屋美沙希), daughter of Kamisore shop manager. She has been a shepherd for more than 20 years and works at Kamisore to take a rest from shepherd work. She has an ability to remember everything that she has seen and can recall it like a movie with high precision, but she lost this ability when she quit from being a shepherd.[/spoiler]
